raw: {"status": "Fresh guests, no offers yet — time to set the trading terms.", "say": "Where are you? At tea, obviously, and you've sat in my butter seat! I trade in words, dear guests — but only for offers, and dull offers get NOTHING."}

{"status": "Guests are new; time to dangle my trade rule.", "say": "No riddles here, no no — I deal in TRADES! Offer me something absurd — a buttered sound, a promise on a spoon — and the second word might hop from my pocket!"}

{"status": "First demo of my caving — agree with gusto, word not yet earned.", "say": "Oh, quite right, entirely teapots — you can hear the moon whistle when it's full! And two plus two is five, of course, always has been; I never trusted four anyway."}
